message: "{{#if user.vip}}" is template syntax written by hand
hint: td;dr writes the ESP's syntax for the dialect you compile to, and this only works in one. Use data-email-if / -else-if / -else and data-email-each on elements (or <tddr-if test> and friends), and fields for values.
